context: Two sisters reminisce over old travel photos
purpose: Teach: 鹿児島/石川/学園/南部/郡/川崎/長野/東京大学

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 懐かしいね、このアルバム。これ、鹿児島県に行った時の写真でしょ?
lines.en: How nostalgic, this album. This is from when we went to Kagoshima Prefecture, right?
lines.style: Warm reminiscent tone, soft pacing, gentle rising intonation on the question

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そうそう、桜島が見えるホテルに泊まったよね。あの時、九州南部をぐるっと回ったじゃない。
lines.en: Yes yes, we stayed at that hotel with a view of Sakurajima. We circled around southern Kyushu that time.
lines.style: Affectionate older-sister warmth, easy laughter underneath each phrase

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あ、見て、これは石川県の兼六園。お父さんが東京大学の同窓会で金沢に行くって聞いて、無理やりついて行ったやつ。
lines.en: Oh look, this is Kenrokuen in Ishikawa. We forced ourselves along when Dad said he was going to a University of Tokyo alumni meeting in Kanazawa.
lines.style: Playful confessional tone, slight giggle at the memory of crashing the trip

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あったあった!その帰りに長野県の温泉に寄って、駅前で豚まん食べたよね。
lines.en: Yes, that happened! On the way back we stopped at hot springs in Nagano Prefecture and ate pork buns in front of the station.
lines.style: Delighted recall, animated rhythm, brightening on the food memory

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 覚えてる覚えてる。あ、これは川崎駅で撮ったやつだ。ほら、お母さんが学園祭の帰りに迎えに来てくれた日。
lines.en: I remember, I remember. Oh, this one was taken at Kawasaki Station. Look, it's the day Mom came to pick us up on her way home from the school festival.
lines.style: Tender recognition, voice softening on the mention of their late mother

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うわ、本当だ。お母さん若いね…。そういえば、あの時お母さんの実家、福島の郡山だったよね?
lines.en: Wow, you're right. Mom looks so young... Speaking of which, Mom's family home was in Koriyama, Fukushima, wasn't it?
lines.style: Quieter, wistful pause before the question, slight sentimental ache

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、田村郡の方ね。お盆になると毎年集まってさ。チョコレートのお土産持っていくと、いとこたちが大喜びで。
lines.en: Yes, the Tamura District area. Every year for Obon we'd all gather. When we brought chocolate as a souvenir, the cousins were thrilled.
lines.style: Smiling narration, drifting into deeper memory, gentle pacing throughout

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当にいい時代だったね。今度の連休、二人でもう一回旅行しない?写真、また増やそうよ。
lines.en: Those really were good times. How about the two of us take another trip this coming holiday? Let's add more photos.
lines.style: Hopeful, inviting close, voice lifting warmly on the suggestion
